meals.name: Tomato & spinach pasta
steps: Boil the pasta in water until tender following the packet time. Reserve a mug of cooking water, then drain.
Warm the oil and passata in a pan for 8 minutes. Stir in spinach until wilted, add pasta and seasoning, then loosen with a little pasta water. Top with Parmesan.

meals.name: Pesto pea pasta
steps: Boil the pasta in water until tender following the packet time. Reserve a mug of cooking water, then drain.
Add the peas to the pasta water for the last 3 minutes. Toss drained pasta and peas with pesto, oil, seasoning and a splash of pasta water. Finish with Parmesan.

meals.name: Creamy mushroom pasta
steps: Boil the pasta in water until tender following the packet time. Reserve a mug of cooking water, then drain.
Slice mushrooms and mince garlic. Fry mushrooms in oil for 7 minutes, add garlic for 1 minute, then cream for 3 minutes. Toss with pasta, seasoning and Parmesan.

meals.name: Lemon ricotta pasta
steps: Boil the pasta in water until tender following the packet time. Reserve a mug of cooking water, then drain.
Mix ricotta with lemon zest, lemon juice to taste, oil and seasoning. Wilt spinach into the hot drained pasta. Stir in ricotta mixture and enough reserved water to make a sauce.

meals.name: Black bean & corn tacos
steps: Warm the tortillas in a dry pan or as directed on the packet. Cut the lime into wedges.
Heat beans and corn with oil and taco seasoning plus a splash of water for 6 minutes. Fill tortillas, add salsa and grated cheddar, and serve with lime.

meals.name: Chicken fajita tacos
steps: Warm the tortillas in a dry pan or as directed on the packet. Cut the lime into wedges.

Slice chicken and vegetables. Cook chicken in oil over medium heat, add vegetables and seasoning and cook until vegetables soften and the chicken reaches 74°C in the thickest pieces. Fill tortillas and top with salsa and lime.

meals.name: Mushroom & avocado tacos
steps: Warm the tortillas in a dry pan or as directed on the packet. Cut the lime into wedges.
Slice mushrooms and sauté in oil with seasoning for 8–10 minutes. Slice avocado. Fill tortillas with mushrooms, cabbage and avocado; squeeze over lime.

meals.name: Beef & cheddar tacos
steps: Warm the tortillas in a dry pan or as directed on the packet. Cut the lime into wedges.
Brown beef in oil, breaking it apart. Stir in seasoning and a little water; simmer until beef reaches 71°C. Fill tortillas with beef, grated cheese, shredded lettuce and salsa. Serve with lime.

meals.name: Margherita flatbread pizzas
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C. Place flatbreads on a lined tray, brush edges with oil, spread with sauce and add grated mozzarella.
Halve tomatoes and scatter over the pizzas. Bake 8–12 minutes until the cheese bubbles and the bases are crisp. Finish with torn basil.

meals.name: Pepperoni & hot honey pizzas
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C. Place flatbreads on a lined tray, brush edges with oil, spread with sauce and add grated mozzarella.
Top with ready-to-eat pepperoni and bake 8–12 minutes until crisp and bubbling. Drizzle with hot honey.

meals.name: Mushroom & pepper pizzas
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C. Place flatbreads on a lined tray, brush edges with oil, spread with sauce and add grated mozzarella.
Thinly slice mushrooms and pepper. Scatter over the pizzas and bake 12–15 minutes until the vegetables soften and the cheese bubbles.

meals.name: Pesto tomato pizzas
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C. Place flatbreads on a lined tray, brush edges with oil, spread with sauce and add grated mozzarella.
Dot pesto over the cheese, add halved tomatoes and bake 8–12 minutes until the bases are crisp and the cheese bubbles.

meals.name: Rotisserie chicken Caesar wraps
steps: Warm tortillas briefly if needed and wash and shred the lettuce.
Toss shredded cooked chicken with lettuce, dressing, pepper and Parmesan. Divide between tortillas, fold in the sides and roll tightly.

meals.name: Hummus crunch wraps
steps: Warm tortillas briefly if needed and wash and shred the lettuce.
Grate carrot and chop cucumber. Spread hummus over tortillas, add lettuce, vegetables, crumbled feta and pepper, then fold and roll.

meals.name: Buffalo chicken wraps
steps: Warm tortillas briefly if needed and wash and shred the lettuce.
Toss cooked chicken with buffalo sauce. Fill wraps with lettuce, chicken, pepper and ranch, then fold and roll. For a hot wrap, reheat chicken to 74°C before assembling.

meals.name: Chickpea salad wraps
steps: Warm tortillas briefly if needed and wash and shred the lettuce.
Mash chickpeas with mayonnaise, mustard and pepper. Stir in finely diced celery, spoon over lettuce in tortillas, then fold and roll.

meals.name: Classic egg fried rice
steps: Cook rice according to its packet. Spread it on a clean plate briefly to let steam escape; use straight away. Whisk the eggs.
Heat half the oil in a large pan, scramble the eggs until set and transfer to a plate.
Heat remaining oil and cook frozen vegetables until piping hot. Add rice and soy sauce, stir-fry for 3 minutes, then fold in egg and sliced green onions.

meals.name: Tofu fried rice
steps: Cook rice according to its packet. Spread it on a clean plate briefly to let steam escape; use straight away. Whisk the eggs.
Heat half the oil in a large pan, scramble the eggs until set and transfer to a plate.
Pat tofu dry and cube. Fry in remaining oil until golden, add vegetables and heat through, then rice and soy sauce. Stir-fry for 3 minutes and fold in egg and sliced green onions.

meals.name: Kimchi fried rice
steps: Cook rice according to its packet. Spread it on a clean plate briefly to let steam escape; use straight away. Whisk the eggs.
Heat half the oil in a large pan, scramble the eggs until set and transfer to a plate.
Chop kimchi and stir-fry in remaining oil with vegetables until hot. Add rice and soy sauce for 3 minutes, then egg and sesame oil. Taste before adding any extra soy sauce.

meals.name: Pineapple fried rice
steps: Cook rice according to its packet. Spread it on a clean plate briefly to let steam escape; use straight away. Whisk the eggs.
Heat half the oil in a large pan, scramble the eggs until set and transfer to a plate.
Heat vegetables in remaining oil, add drained pineapple and rice and stir-fry for 3 minutes. Add soy sauce, egg and cashews; toss until hot.

meals.name: Black bean quesadillas
steps: Grate the cheddar. Mash the beans with half the salsa. Divide beans and cheese over one half of each tortilla and fold over.
Cook in oil in a frying pan over medium heat for 2–3 minutes per side until crisp and melted. Serve with the remaining salsa.

meals.name: Chicken salsa quesadillas
steps: Grate the cheddar and shred the cooked chicken. Divide chicken, cheese and salsa over one half of each tortilla and fold over.
Cook in oil in a frying pan over medium heat for 3–4 minutes per side, turning gently, until crisp and the filling reaches 74°C.

meals.name: Corn & pepper quesadillas
steps: Grate the cheddar and set out the tortillas.

Before filling, finely dice pepper and fry with corn in half the oil for 5 minutes. Fill tortillas with vegetables and cheese, fold over, then fry in remaining oil 2–3 minutes per side. Serve with salsa.

meals.name: Spinach & feta quesadillas
steps: Grate the cheddar and set out the tortillas.

Before filling, wilt spinach in a splash of water and squeeze dry. Fill tortillas with spinach, crumbled feta and cheddar. Fold over and cook in oil over medium heat for 2–3 minutes per side until crisp.

meals.name: Chickpea spinach curry
steps: Cook rice according to the packet. Dice onion and soften in oil for 5 minutes. Stir in curry powder for 30 seconds.
Add chickpeas, tomatoes, coconut milk and salt; simmer 12 minutes. Fold in spinach until wilted and serve over rice.

meals.name: Sweet potato curry
steps: Cook rice according to the packet. Dice onion and soften in oil for 5 minutes. Stir in curry powder for 30 seconds.
Peel and dice sweet potato into 1 cm cubes. Add with tomatoes, coconut milk, salt and 100 ml water per 2 servings. Simmer 20 minutes until tender, stir in peas for 3 minutes and serve over rice.

meals.name: Coconut chicken curry
steps: Cook rice according to the packet. Dice onion and soften in oil for 5 minutes. Stir in curry powder for 30 seconds.

Cut chicken into small pieces and slice pepper. Add to the onion pan and stir for 3 minutes, then add tomatoes, coconut milk and salt. Simmer until chicken reaches 74°C, around 15 minutes. Serve over rice.

meals.name: Tofu & broccoli curry
steps: Cook rice according to the packet. Dice onion and soften in oil for 5 minutes. Stir in curry powder for 30 seconds.

Cube tofu and cut broccoli into small florets. Add tofu, coconut milk, salt and 100 ml water per 2 servings. Simmer 8 minutes; add broccoli and simmer until tender, about 6 minutes. Finish with lime juice and serve with rice.

meals.name: Teriyaki tofu bowls
steps: Cook rice according to the packet. Slice cucumber and grate carrot. Divide rice and vegetables between bowls.
Pat tofu dry, cube and fry in sesame oil until golden. Add teriyaki sauce and heat through. Spoon over bowls, adding soy sauce to taste.

meals.name: Edamame crunch bowls
steps: Cook rice according to the packet. Slice cucumber and grate carrot. Divide rice and vegetables between bowls.
Cook edamame according to its packet, drain and add to the bowls. Top with sliced avocado, soy sauce and sesame oil.

meals.name: Korean style beef bowls
steps: Cook rice according to the packet. Slice cucumber and grate carrot. Divide rice and vegetables between bowls.
Brown beef in a pan, breaking it apart, until it reaches 71°C. Stir in gochujang, soy sauce and sesame oil with a splash of water. Spoon over rice and garnish with sliced green onions.

meals.name: Teriyaki salmon bowls
steps: Cook rice according to the packet. Slice cucumber and grate carrot. Divide rice and vegetables between bowls.

Brush salmon with teriyaki sauce and bake on a lined tray at 200°C until it reaches 70°C, approximately 12–18 minutes depending on thickness. Add to bowls and drizzle with sesame oil and soy sauce to taste.

meals.name: Greek chickpea dinner salad
steps: Wash and dry leaves, chop cucumber and halve tomatoes. Toss with olive oil, lemon juice and pepper.
Fold chickpeas, crumbled feta and olives into the salad. Serve with warmed pita bread.

meals.name: Chicken & avocado salad
steps: Wash and dry leaves, chop cucumber and halve tomatoes. Toss with olive oil, lemon juice and pepper.
Top salad with shredded cooked chicken and sliced avocado. Serve with bread rolls.

meals.name: Tuna & white bean salad
steps: Wash and dry leaves, chop cucumber and halve tomatoes. Toss with olive oil, lemon juice and pepper.
Fold drained tuna and beans gently into the salad. Serve with bread rolls.

meals.name: Halloumi dinner salad
steps: Wash and dry leaves, chop cucumber and halve tomatoes. Toss with olive oil, lemon juice and pepper.
Slice halloumi and fry in a nonstick pan until golden on each side. Add to the salad and serve with warmed pita.

meals.name: Broccoli cheddar potatoes
steps: Heat oven to 220°C. Scrub potatoes, prick with a fork, rub with oil and salt and bake 50–65 minutes until completely tender. For speed, microwave until tender first, then crisp in the oven for 10 minutes.
Steam broccoli until tender. Split potatoes, add broccoli and grated cheese and return to oven until cheese melts. Finish with sour cream.

meals.name: BBQ chicken potatoes
steps: Heat oven to 220°C. Scrub potatoes, prick with a fork, rub with oil and salt and bake 50–65 minutes until completely tender. For speed, microwave until tender first, then crisp in the oven for 10 minutes.
Heat shredded chicken with BBQ sauce and a little water until it reaches 74°C. Split potatoes, fill with chicken and top with grated cheddar.

meals.name: Black bean salsa potatoes
steps: Heat oven to 220°C. Scrub potatoes, prick with a fork, rub with oil and salt and bake 50–65 minutes until completely tender. For speed, microwave until tender first, then crisp in the oven for 10 minutes.
Heat beans with salsa in a pan until piping hot. Split potatoes, spoon in beans and finish with grated cheddar.

meals.name: Tuna sweetcorn potatoes
steps: Heat oven to 220°C. Scrub potatoes, prick with a fork, rub with oil and salt and bake 50–65 minutes until completely tender. For speed, microwave until tender first, then crisp in the oven for 10 minutes.
Mix tuna, corn and mayonnaise. Split the hot potatoes and spoon over the tuna mixture.

meals.name: Classic grilled cheese & soup
steps: Grate cheese and butter one side of each bread slice. Heat tomato soup following its packet directions.
Make sandwiches with cheese inside and butter on the outside. Fry over medium-low heat for 3–4 minutes per side until golden and fully melted. Serve with soup.

meals.name: Pesto grilled cheese & soup
steps: Grate cheese and butter one side of each bread slice. Heat tomato soup following its packet directions.
Spread pesto on the unbuttered sides, fill with cheese and sandwich with butter outside. Fry over medium-low heat for 3–4 minutes per side until golden and melted. Serve with soup.

meals.name: Apple cheddar melts & soup
steps: Grate cheese and butter one side of each bread slice. Heat tomato soup following its packet directions.
Thinly slice apple and layer with cheese between the unbuttered sides. Fry sandwiches over medium-low heat for 3–4 minutes per side until golden and melted. Serve with soup.

meals.name: Kimchi melts & soup
steps: Grate cheese and butter one side of each bread slice. Heat tomato soup following its packet directions.
Drain and chop kimchi, then layer with cheese between unbuttered sides. Fry sandwiches over medium-low heat for 3–4 minutes per side until crisp and melted. Serve with soup.

meals.name: Garlic tofu noodle stir-fry
steps: Cook noodles according to the packet and drain. Slice pepper, cut broccoli into small florets and mix soy sauce with cornstarch and 60 ml water per 2 servings.

Cube and dry tofu; fry in oil until golden, then set aside. Stir-fry vegetables with a splash of water until tender. Add minced garlic for 30 seconds, then tofu, noodles and sauce. Toss until sauce thickens.

meals.name: Chicken & broccoli noodles
steps: Cook noodles according to the packet and drain. Slice pepper, cut broccoli into small florets and mix soy sauce with cornstarch and 60 ml water per 2 servings.
Slice chicken and fry in oil. Add vegetables and minced garlic, stir-frying until vegetables soften and chicken reaches 74°C. Add noodles and sauce; toss until thickened.

meals.name: Cashew vegetable noodles
steps: Cook noodles according to the packet and drain. Slice pepper, cut broccoli into small florets and mix soy sauce with cornstarch and 60 ml water per 2 servings.
Slice mushrooms and fry in oil for 5 minutes. Add pepper and broccoli with a splash of water and cook until tender. Stir in noodles, sauce and cashews until thickened and hot.

meals.name: Ginger beef noodle stir-fry
steps: Cook noodles according to the packet and drain. Slice pepper, cut broccoli into small florets and mix soy sauce with cornstarch and 60 ml water per 2 servings.

Sear beef strips in oil and set aside. Stir-fry vegetables with grated ginger and a splash of water until tender. Return beef, add noodles and sauce, and heat until the beef reaches at least 63°C. Rest the beef for 3 minutes before serving.

meals.name: Tomato & white bean soup
steps: Dice onion and carrots. Soften in oil in a large saucepan for 7 minutes.
Add tomatoes, stock and beans. Simmer for 18 minutes until carrots are tender. Season with pepper and serve with rolls.

meals.name: Red lentil soup
steps: Dice onion and carrots. Soften in oil in a large saucepan for 7 minutes.
Rinse lentils and add with tomatoes, stock, cumin and pepper. Simmer 20–25 minutes until lentils and carrots are tender, adding water as needed. Serve with rolls.

meals.name: Chicken noodle soup
steps: Dice onion and carrots. Soften in oil in a large saucepan for 7 minutes.
Add stock and 250 ml water per 2 servings. Bring to a simmer, add pasta and cook for the packet time. Add shredded chicken and pepper and heat until chicken reaches 74°C.

meals.name: Chickpea spinach soup
steps: Dice onion and carrots. Soften in oil in a large saucepan for 7 minutes.
Add chickpeas, tomatoes, stock and pepper. Simmer 18 minutes until carrots are tender, fold in spinach until wilted and serve with rolls.

meals.name: Three bean chili
steps: Cook rice according to the packet. Dice onion and soften in oil in a large saucepan for 5 minutes.
Add spices, all beans and tomatoes with 100 ml water per 2 servings. Simmer 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Serve over rice.

meals.name: Classic beef chili
steps: Cook rice according to the packet. Dice onion and soften in oil in a large saucepan for 5 minutes.
Add beef to onions and brown while breaking it apart. Stir in spices, kidney beans, tomatoes and 100 ml water per 2 servings. Simmer 25 minutes, ensuring beef reaches 71°C. Serve over rice.

meals.name: Sweet potato black bean chili
steps: Cook rice according to the packet. Dice onion and soften in oil in a large saucepan for 5 minutes.
Peel and dice sweet potato into small cubes. Add with spices, beans, tomatoes and 150 ml water per 2 servings. Simmer 25–30 minutes until potato is tender. Serve over rice.

meals.name: Corn & lentil chili
steps: Cook rice according to the packet. Dice onion and soften in oil in a large saucepan for 5 minutes.
Add spices, lentils, kidney beans, corn and tomatoes with 100 ml water per 2 servings. Simmer 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Serve over rice.

meals.name: Cheddar scramble on toast
steps: Toast the bread. Whisk eggs with salt and pepper.
Melt butter over medium-low heat, add eggs and stir gently until set. Fold in grated cheddar and serve over toast.

meals.name: Mushroom scramble on toast
steps: Toast the bread. Whisk eggs with salt and pepper.
Slice mushrooms and sauté in butter until tender. Add eggs and gently scramble until set. Serve over toast.

meals.name: Spinach feta eggs on toast
steps: Toast the bread. Whisk eggs with salt and pepper.
Wilt spinach in butter, add eggs and stir gently until set. Fold in crumbled feta and serve over toast.

meals.name: Avocado eggs on toast
steps: Toast the bread. Whisk eggs with salt and pepper.
Mash avocado with a squeeze of lime and spread on toast. Scramble eggs in butter until set and spoon over the avocado.

meals.name: Tofu mushroom ramen
steps: Slice mushrooms and green onions. Sauté mushrooms in sesame oil for 5 minutes, then add stock and soy sauce and bring to a simmer.
Add cubed tofu and noodles, cooking for the noodle packet time. Stir in spinach until wilted. Serve topped with green onions.

meals.name: Chicken noodle ramen
steps: Slice mushrooms and green onions. Sauté mushrooms in sesame oil for 5 minutes, then add stock and soy sauce and bring to a simmer.
Add shredded chicken and noodles, cooking for the noodle packet time and until chicken reaches 74°C. Add spinach until wilted and top with green onions.

meals.name: Miso corn ramen
steps: Slice mushrooms and green onions. Sauté mushrooms in sesame oil for 5 minutes, then add stock and soy sauce and bring to a simmer.
Add corn, cubed tofu and noodles and cook for the noodle packet time. Turn off heat, dissolve miso in a ladle of broth and stir it back in. Top with green onions.

meals.name: Kimchi tofu ramen
steps: Slice mushrooms and green onions. Sauté mushrooms in sesame oil for 5 minutes, then add stock and soy sauce and bring to a simmer.
Add chopped kimchi, cubed tofu and noodles. Simmer for the noodle packet time and serve with green onions.

meals.name: Halloumi & vegetable tray bake
steps: Heat oven to 220°C. Cut potatoes into 2 cm chunks, slice peppers and onion. Toss with oil and seasonings on a large tray; roast 20 minutes.
Add thick halloumi slices and roast 12–15 minutes more until potatoes are tender and halloumi is golden. Squeeze over lemon.

meals.name: Chicken & vegetable tray bake
steps: Heat oven to 220°C. Cut potatoes into 2 cm chunks, slice peppers and onion. Toss with oil and seasonings on a large tray; roast 20 minutes.
Add chicken in a single layer and roast another 20–25 minutes, until chicken reaches 74°C and potatoes are tender. Squeeze over lemon.

meals.name: Chickpea & vegetable tray bake
steps: Heat oven to 220°C. Cut potatoes into 2 cm chunks, slice peppers and onion. Toss with oil and seasonings on a large tray; roast 20 minutes.
Add drained chickpeas and roast another 15–20 minutes until potatoes are tender. Top with crumbled feta.

meals.name: Salmon & vegetable tray bake
steps: Heat oven to 220°C. Cut potatoes into 2 cm chunks, slice peppers and onion. Toss with oil and seasonings on a large tray; roast 20 minutes.
Add salmon and roast another 12–18 minutes until fish reaches 70°C and potatoes are tender. Serve with lemon wedges.

meals.name: Spinach & ricotta pasta bake
steps: Heat oven to 200°C. Boil pasta for 2 minutes less than its packet time, reserve a mug of water, then drain.
Wilt spinach into the hot pasta. Mix pasta, passata, herbs, pepper and a splash of pasta water in a baking dish. Dot over ricotta and top with grated mozzarella. Bake 20 minutes until bubbling.

meals.name: Tuna pasta bake
steps: Heat oven to 200°C. Boil pasta for 2 minutes less than its packet time, reserve a mug of water, then drain.
Mix pasta, tuna, corn, passata, herbs, pepper and a splash of pasta water in a baking dish. Top with mozzarella and bake 20–25 minutes until the centre reaches 74°C.

meals.name: White bean pasta bake
steps: Heat oven to 200°C. Boil pasta for 2 minutes less than its packet time, reserve a mug of water, then drain.
Wilt spinach into the hot pasta. Mix with beans, passata, herbs, pepper and a splash of pasta water in a baking dish. Top with mozzarella and bake 20 minutes until bubbling.

meals.name: Chicken mozzarella pasta bake
steps: Heat oven to 200°C. Boil pasta for 2 minutes less than its packet time, reserve a mug of water, then drain.

Wilt spinach into the hot pasta. Mix with shredded chicken, passata, herbs, pepper and a splash of pasta water in a baking dish. Top with mozzarella and bake 20–25 minutes until the centre reaches 74°C.

meals.name: Classic cheeseburgers
steps: Wash lettuce, slice tomato and toast buns if you like.
Form beef into two patties per 2 servings and season. Cook in oil over medium heat, turning until the centre reaches 71°C. Melt cheese on top, then serve in buns with lettuce, tomato and ketchup.

meals.name: Halloumi burgers
steps: Wash lettuce, slice tomato and toast buns if you like.
Slice halloumi into thick slabs, season lightly with pepper and fry in oil until golden on both sides. Put in buns with lettuce, tomato and sweet chili sauce; salt only to taste.

meals.name: Veggie cheeseburgers
steps: Wash lettuce, slice tomato and toast buns if you like.
Cook patties according to their packet directions. Melt cheddar over the hot patties and serve in buns with lettuce, tomato and ketchup. Season to taste.

meals.name: Chicken pesto burgers
steps: Wash lettuce, slice tomato and toast buns if you like.
Cut chicken into even cutlets, season and fry in oil over medium heat until the centre reaches 74°C. Spread buns with pesto and add chicken, lettuce and tomato.

meals.name: Dumplings with sesame slaw
steps: Steam broccoli until tender. Cook dumplings following their packet instructions, including the safe internal temperature for their filling.
Toss cabbage with sesame oil, rice vinegar and soy sauce. If suitable for the packet method, crisp cooked dumplings in oil. Serve with broccoli and slaw.

meals.name: Chili crisp dumpling bowls
steps: Steam broccoli until tender. Cook dumplings following their packet instructions, including the safe internal temperature for their filling.
If suitable for the packet method, crisp cooked dumplings in oil. Mix chili crisp with soy sauce. Spoon over dumplings and broccoli and add sliced green onions.

meals.name: Peanut sauce dumplings
steps: Steam broccoli until tender. Cook dumplings following their packet instructions, including the safe internal temperature for their filling.
Whisk peanut butter with soy sauce, lime juice and warm water to a drizzling consistency. Crisp cooked dumplings in oil if suitable for their packet method. Serve with broccoli and peanut sauce.

meals.name: Ginger soy dumplings
steps: Steam broccoli until tender. Cook dumplings following their packet instructions, including the safe internal temperature for their filling.
Mix grated ginger, vinegar and soy sauce. Crisp cooked dumplings in oil if suitable for their packet method. Serve with broccoli, dipping sauce and sliced green onions.
